summary.zh: 一批界面细节修复：评论操作菜单不再跑偏，「我」页不再残留账号切换块，工作流列表新增脚本/分支筛选。
summary.en: A batch of UI polish: the comment action menu stays put, the profile tab no longer shows a stray account block, and the Workflows tab gains script/branch filters.

items.zh: 修复：issue 评论的「编辑/删除/复制」菜单弹窗位置漂移，现在紧贴省略号按钮弹出
items.en: Comment edit/delete/copy popup no longer drifts — it opens right under the ellipsis button

items.zh: 修复：工作流详情页已下载过的构建产物重进页面后显示异常、点击无响应，现在能正确恢复文件列表
items.en: Run artifacts already downloaded now restore their file list on revisits instead of showing a dead download button

items.zh: 修复：「我」页底部残留的多余账号切换块（设置页已有完整账号管理）
items.en: Removed the stray account switcher at the bottom of the profile tab (Settings already has full account management)

items.zh: 工作流 tab 新增筛选 chips：上行选运行脚本、下行选分支，均可横滑；仓库无工作流脚本时不显示，仅一个分支时隐藏分支行
items.en: Workflows tab filter chips: pick a workflow (row 1) and/or branch (row 2), horizontally scrollable; hidden entirely when the repo has no workflow scripts, branch row hidden with ≤1 branch
